en: The Dyad on Roots to be Abandoned by Cultivation, and the Triad on the Wholesome.

Dependent on a wholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation (*na-bhāvanāya-pahātabba-hetuka*), there arises a non-wholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state whose root is to be abandoned by cultivation (*bhāvanāya-pahātabba-hetuka*), there arises a non-unwholesome state whose root is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition.
… Under the root condition: three … pe … under the non-disappearance condition: three. (The indeterminate roots: two.)
With respect to cause, two; with respect to object, three ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
